dependency.name: cranelift-codegen
dependency.contract: Nontrapping memory permits removal of unused loads and dead stores at their current program points. It does not imply arbitrary movement, readonly memory or alignment.

facts.fact: Checked allocation byte counts and limits precede a typed host-arena projection retained together with its memory domain.
The projection exactly covers its arena; every lane is initialized with T::default before exposure. u64 is a sealed supported lane type.

Checked private metadata counts extend the local bank. The owned projection is split into bounded slices; frame pointers/capacities reference those slices and stay borrowed across the synchronous entry call.
Ready, capture and temporary homes are derived with checked additions and disjoint offsets into the reserved borrowed bank.
Origin flags apply only for CodePlan::is_program; other image kinds use default memory flags.
Source bounds and opaque callback memory effects must remain. No promise is proposed for general source bytes, LF allocations, map payloads or callback argument/result buffers.

remaining: Differential callback/window and finite-work regressions at this exact source

call_site_scope.extent: Exactly NativeEntryFrame.error_node; flags selected only for CodePlan::Program.
call_site_scope.lifetime: Initialized stack Frame remains live for synchronous entry; no source pointer is dereferenced.

call_site_scope.extent: Checked borrowed RegionLayout ready..end. Each view has two words and each matrix three; slot derivation precedes code emission. Clear loops iterate only this range.
call_site_scope.lifetime: Homes lie within the owned initialized locals projection; clearing source loans never deallocates this private bank. Actual pointed-to source/row reads retain default flags.

call_site_scope.source: program_tail_codegen.rs load/store/leave/prepare/header and program_prefix_codegen.rs exit clear
call_site_scope.extent: Only map=None uses these flags, with exactly three checked words: ready, compute, comparison. Branches using words+3/+4 require map=Some and retain default flags.
call_site_scope.lifetime: Tail layouts extend the same owned locals projection using checked additions. Whole bank remains allocated across callback resumes and synchronous entry.

call_site_scope.source: iteration_compiler.rs Program-only layout derivation; program_session.rs setup_geometry and run; program_hooks.rs
call_site_scope.extent: No other CodePlan kind derives borrowed/closed layouts. Exact u64 arena default initialization, capacities and disjoint slices precede entry.
call_site_scope.lifetime: Opaque ordinary helper calls remain full memory barriers. All source bounds/error branches, loan clearing and callback effects remain. No readonly/aligned/can_move flags are set.
